messages:
Alex: Quick pre-cut check — planning to cut at 21:30 UTC. What I did: landed rollout-policy PR and tweaked autoscaler defaults. Blockers: merge queue stuck on a flaky test `test_batcher_shard` and one missing backport (kv-cache invalidation). Today: I'll debug the CI flake and coordinate the backport.

Maya: Noted. Cherry-picks we need: `kv-cache-backport` (critical), `quantize-hf-lock-fix`, and a small docs tweak. I've pinged owners for each.

Jasper: I'll grab the kv-cache backport — depends on #4567 though. Aiming to open the backport PR by 19:00 UTC. @Alex can you run the canary once it's in? :thumbsup:

Taylor: Canary is currently at 5% (west-1). Observability shows a small p99 bump for ~512 token requests but no increase in error rate. Filed SRE-312 to track. Recommend holding at 5% until backport lands.

release-bot: merge-queue: build failed on job `ci/integration/test_batcher_shard` — rerun queued by automation.

Alex: Logs from the failed job show `OOM in shard 2` on runner-4. Snippet: ```[2026-03-17T18:02:11Z] ERROR: OOM when allocating 1.2GiB on device 0 (runner-4)
stack: ... nvmlGetMemoryInfo ...``` Might be a runner image mismatch with CUDA drivers. @Sam (eng-infra) can you check runner pool?

Sam (eng-infra): We're rolling new runners in west-1 now, ETA ~25m. Requeued the CI job manually (`/ci rerun ci/integration/test_batcher_shard`). Also saw docker cache invalidation on runner-4 — following up.

Maya: I'll update the release notes draft with the three cherry-picks and call out the kv-cache fix as a blocker.

Jasper: FYI tokenizer-hotfix (low priority) may require a tiny data migration (token-mapper). If that becomes required we should schedule a maintenance window — flagging now.

Taylor: If migration is needed, prefer 03:00–05:00 PST low-traffic window. Ping db-team for feasibility.

Priya (db-team): We can do a live 2-phase swap that keeps downtime minimal (~10m on secondary). Need exact migration script and a final signoff 24h prior.

Alex: Action items: Jasper — backport PR by 19:00 UTC; Sam — confirm runner rollout in 30m; Taylor — hold canary at 5%; Priya — prep migration plan if tokenizer change lands. If any blocker remains at 20:30 UTC we delay the cut. I'll post final go/no-go at 21:10 UTC.

Maya: Ack. Small process note: please use `release:hold` label to gate merges instead of long comment threads — easier for automation.

Jasper: Quick ping to @Taylor for CR #4589 (quantization knobs) — needs a short perf sanity pass.

Taylor: On it, running perf harness now; will share a 1-line pass/fail in ~15m.

Alex: Thanks everyone. If CI flake persists after the runner swap, we can fallback to creating a temporary job with `--no-gpu-cache` to unblock merges:```bazel test //integration:batcher --test_tag_filters=-gpu_cache```

Sam (eng-infra): Confirmed runner rollout finished at 19:12 UTC, requeued jobs are green so far.

Maya: Great, looks like green. I'll merge release notes draft and queue the cut once Jasper's PR lands.

Jasper: Backport PR opened: #4598 — linking here. @Alex please trigger the canary when convenient.

Taylor: Perf sanity: quant knobs look stable on my harness (no perf regression within noise). Recommend proceed.

Alex: Go for canary increase to 25% in west-1, keep global at 5% for 15m, then evaluate. Posting go/no-go in 21m. :rocket:
